species.summary: Cyclommatus is a genus of the Lucanidae family, also known as the stag beetle. The majority of the species from the genus Cyclommatus are located in Southeast Asia, though some species can be found in China and Taiwan as well.
Harpa harpa, common name the true harp or the noble harp, is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Harpidae, the harp snails.
Isis hippuris is a species of bamboo coral found in the Western Pacific Ocean. It produces hippuristanol, a molecule with apparent anti-cancer functions.
Lyssa menoetius is a moth of the family Uraniidae. The species was first described by German entomologist Hopffer in 1856.
Nardoa is a genus of sea stars in the family Ophidiasteridae.
Notodoris serenae is a species of sea slug. It is a dorid nudibranch, a shell-less marine gastropod mollusc in the family Aegiridae.
Ocypode cordimanus is a species of crab in the family Ocypodidae, sometimes called the smooth-handed ghost crab. It is widely distributed in the Indian Ocean and Pacific Ocean.
Papilio paris, the Paris peacock, is a species of swallowtail butterfly found in the Indian subcontinent and Southeast Asia.

Parnara bada, the African straight swift, grey swift or Ceylon swift, is a butterfly of the Hesperiidae family. It is found in south-east Asia, from India through China to Indonesia, as well as the north-east coast of Australia.

Pystira ephippigera adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Salticidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Pystira dan ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1885 oleh Simon.
Terebellum terebellum, common name the Terebellum conch, is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Seraphsidae, the true conchs.
Angaria delphinus, common name the common delphinula, is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusc of the family Angariidae.
Atrophaneura dixoni is a species of butterfly from the family Papilionidae that is found in northern and central Sulawesi, Indonesia.
Chromodoris dianae is a species of sea slug, a dorid nudibranch, a shell-less marine gastropod mollusc in the family Chromodorididae.

The north Moluccan cicadabird (Edolisoma grayi) is a passerine bird in the family Campephagidae that is found on Halmahera, the Bacan Islands, the Tukangbesi Islands and the island of Morotai in the northern Moluccas Islands of Indonesia.

Culex quinquefasciatus Say, 1823 (originally named Culex fatigans), commonly known as the southern house mosquito, is a medium-sized mosquito found in tropical and subtropical regions of the world. It is the vector of Wuchereria bancrofti, avian malaria, and arboviruses including St.
Delias oraia is a butterfly in the family Pieridae. It was described by William Doherty in 1891. It is found in the Australasian realm.
Euploea crameri, the spotted black crow, is a butterfly found in Asia that belongs to the crows and tigers, that is, the Danaid group of the brush-footed butterflies family.

Gea bituberculata adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Araneidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1881 oleh Thorell.

Gelliodes fibulata adalah spesies spons yang tergolong dalam kelas Demospongiae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Gelliodes dan famili Niphatidae. Nama ilmiah spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1881 oleh Carter.
Glenea venus is a species of beetle in the family Cerambycidae. It was described by James Thomson in 1865. It is known from Papua New Guinea, Australia and Indonesia.

Gnathothlibus eras is a moth of the family Sphingidae. It is known from the eastern Sunda Islands (from Java eastward), Sulawesi, the Moluccas, the Philippines, New Guinea, the Solomon Islands, Micronesia and eastern Australia.
Hasora taminatus, the white banded awl, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae, which is found in Asia.

species.name: eteman
species.summary: Mene maculata, the Moonfish, is the only extant member of the genus Mene and of the family Menidae. The body is highly compressed laterally and very deep vertically. The ventral profile is steep, with a sharp ventral edge. The caudal (tail) fin is deeply forked. The mouth is small and protrusible.
Mithrodia clavigera is a species of tropical starfish in the family Mithrodiidae.

Acherontia styx, the lesser death's head hawkmoth or bee robber, is a sphingid moth found in Asia, one of the three species of death's-head hawkmoth. It is very fond of honey, and bee keepers have reported finding dead moths in their hives as a result of bee stings.
Adelomorpha is a genus of moths in the family Gelechiidae. It contains the species Adelomorpha ritsemae, which is found on Sulawesi, an island in Indonesia.
Gobi pembawa telur (Adrianichthys oophorus) adalah sebuah spesies ikan dari famili Adrianichthyidae. Spesies ini termasuk jenis yang endemik di Danau Poso di Sulawesi, Indonesia.

Amblypodia narada is a species of butterfly belonging to the lycaenid family described by Thomas Horsfield in 1828. It is found in Southeast Asia (Java, Borneo, Philippines, Sulawesi, southern Burma, Thailand, Peninsular Malaya and Sumatra).
Ambulyx celebensis is a species of moth in the family Sphingidae. It was described by Jordan in 1919, and is known from Indonesia.
Amphidromus porcellanus is a species of air-breathing land snail, a terrestrial pulmonate gastropod mollusc in the family Camaenidae.
The bumpnose trevally (Atropus hedlandensis), also known as the bumpnose kingfish or onion kingfish, is a species of relatively small inshore marine fish classified in the jack family Carangidae.

Celaenorrhinus ficulnea, the velvet flat, is a species of butterfly in the family Hesperiidae. It is found in south-east Asia. The typical form exhibits the white central spot of the forewing above and beneath straightly cut off by the lower median branch. In some taxonomic schemes (e.g.

Charaxes bernardus, the tawny rajah, is a butterfly that belongs to the rajahs and nawabs group, that is, the Charaxinae group of the brush-footed butterflies family. This species can be found in India, China, Indomalaya, and onwards to Indonesia.
Papilio veiovis is a species of swallowtail butterfly from the genus Papilio that is found in Sulawesi.
Coenobita cavipes is a species of land hermit crab native to the eastern parts of Africa, the Philippines, China, Japan, Malaysia, Taiwan, Polynesia, and Micronesia.

The rufous hawk-cuckoo or northern hawk-cuckoo (Hierococcyx hyperythrus) is a bird in the family Cuculidae formerly thought to be conspecific with Hodgson's hawk-cuckoo (Hierococcyx fugax) and placed in the genus Cuculus.

Lyclene reticulata is a species of lichen moths of the Erebidae family, Arctiinae subfamily. It is found in Queensland, Australia, as well as on Ambon, Seram, Timor, Batchian, Aru, Tobriand, the Louisiade Archipelago and the Dampier Archipelago,
Delias hypomelas is a butterfly in the family Pieridae. It was described by Walter Rothschild and Karl Jordan in 1907. It is endemic to New Guinea. It has a white form named "argentata"
Hierodula obtusata is a species of praying mantis in the family Mantidae.

Megacorma obliqua is a moth of the family Sphingidae. It is known from Sri Lanka, north-eastern India, Myanmar, south-western China (Yunnan, Hainan), Thailand, northern Vietnam, Malaysia (Peninsular, Sarawak, Sabah), Indonesia (Sumatra, Kalimantan, Java, Ceram, Papua Barat), the Philippines (including Palawan), Papua N…
Miletus leos is a butterfly in the family Lycaenidae. It is found in Asia.
Rhipicephalus sanguineus merupakan ektoparasit umum yang sering menyerang anjing. Ektoparasit ini masuk dalam golongan caplak, sering dikelirukan dengan sebutan kutu.
Tachypompilus analis, the red-tailed spider wasp is a species of spider wasp found in most of tropical and subtropical Asia, north to Japan. These spider wasps often hunt huntsman spiders.

Tenodera aridifolia is a species of mantis in the subfamily Mantinae. Common names include Japanese giant mantis, オオカマキリ oo-kamakiri ("large mantis") in Japan. It is also known as the Chinese mantis, not to be confused with Tenodera sinensis, which has the same common name. T.
Utetheisa lotrix (salt-and-pepper moth) is a moth of the family Erebidae. It is found in most of the old world tropics.
Vanessa buana, the Lompobatang lady, is a butterfly of the Nymphalidae family found on Sulawesi in Indonesia.

Anisoneura salebrosa is a moth of the Noctuidae family. It is found in Taiwan, Thailand, Vietnam, Sumatra, Peninsular Malaysia, Borneo, Sulawesi, the north-eastern part of the Himalaya (Nepal and India), Bangladesh, China, Japan and the Philippines.
Calappa hepatica is a common benthic species of box crab of tropical and subtropical parts of the Indian and Pacific Oceans and the Red Sea.

Kupu-kupu biblis atau Cethosia biblis adalah salah satu spesies kupu-kupu subfamili Heliconiinae yang termasuk dari famili Nymphalidae. Spesies ini tersebar di bagian timur Anak Benua India hingga ke Asia Tenggara dan Asia Timur. Batas paling timur hingga Filipina dan batas paling selatan hingga Indonesia.
Cosmophasis ombria is a species of jumping spider in the family Salticidae. It was originally described as Maevia ombria by Tamerlan Thorell in 1877.

Cosmopolites sordidus (juga dikenali sebagai penggerek bonggol pisang atau kumbang pisang) adalah spesies kumbang moncong yang memakan tanaman pisang. Kumbang ini berasal dari Asia Tenggara dan dianggap sebagai salah satu hama paling kritis yang merusak bagian umbi dan akar maupun batang pada pohon pisang.

Curetis tagalica is a species of butterfly belonging to the lycaenid family. It is found in Southeast Asia (Philippines, Celebes, Palawan, Balabac, Borneo, Sumatra, Javan, Peninsular Malaya and Thailand).
Daphnis protrudens is a moth of the family Sphingidae.
Dideopsis aegrota is a species of hover fly in the family Syrphidae. It is found in South Korea, China, India, Indonesia, Sri Lanka, Nepal, as well as eastern Australia.

Ercheia cyllaria is a species of moth of the Erebidae family. It is found in the Indian subregion, Sri Lanka, Taiwan, Japan, Indochina, Thailand, Peninsular Malaysia, Sumatra, Borneo, Seram and the Kai Islands.
Goniobranchus reticulatus is a species of colourful sea slug or dorid nudibranch, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Chromodorididae.
Pelopidas agna, the obscure branded swift or dark branded swift, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae.
Polytremis lubricans, the contiguous swift, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae.It is found in the Indomalayan realm...
Spilostethus pandurus is a species of "seed bugs" belonging to the family Lygaeidae, subfamily Lygaeinae.

Tubuca coarctata is a species of fiddler crab found in the western Pacific ocean, including Japan, Taiwan, the Philippines, Indonesia, New Guinea and Australia (in Queensland and the Northern Territory).
Udara camenae is a butterfly of the family Lycaenidae. It is found in South-east Asia.
Amblychia infoveata is a moth in the Geometridae family. It is found in Borneo, Peninsular Malaysia and Sumatra.
Argiope chloreis is a species of orb-weaver spider in the family Araneidae. It was first described by Swedish arachnologist Tamerlan Thorell in 1877.

Cantao ocellatus is a species of shield bug in the family Scutelleridae found across Asia. Reddish or ochre in overall colour it has dark legs and bluish black antennae. A dark bluish black stripe is present along the central line of the head.

Charaxes mars, the iron rajah, is a butterfly of the rajahs and nawabs group, i.e. the Charaxinae group of the brush-footed butterflies family. It is endemic to Sulawesi in central Indonesia. Charaxes mars is a large butterfly with forewings with concave outer edge and hindwings each with a tail.

Conopomorpha cramerella, the cocoa pod borer, is a moth of the family Gracillariidae. It is known from Saudi Arabia, China, India (West Bengal, Andaman Islands), Thailand, Brunei, Indonesia (Sumatra, Sulawesi, Papua, Papua Barat, Java, Kalimantan, Moluccas), Malaysia (Peninsula, Sarawak, Sabah), Vietnam, Australia, New…
Epepeotes plorator is a species of beetle in the family Cerambycidae. It was described by Newman in 1842. It is known from Sulawesi and the Philippines.

Euchromia polymena is a moth of the Arctiidae family. It was described by Carl Linnaeus in his 1758 10th edition of Systema Naturae. It is found in India and south-eastern Asia, as well as on Sumatra, Java, Sulawesi, Peninsular Malaysia, Borneo and the Philippines.
Laevistrombus canarium atau yang dikenal dengan nama Siput Laut Gonggong adalah hewan laut jenis kerang-kerangan dengan cangkang halus yang berbentuk gasing oval.

Laomenes amboinensis is a species of shrimp found in waters off Indonesia, Queensland, New Caledonia, the Marshall Islands, the Ryukyu Islands and Papua New Guinea. It was first named by Johannes Govertus de Man in 1888, as Anchistia amboinensis.
Leptocorisa biguttata is a species of bug.
Leptosia lignea, the Sulawesi wood white, is a butterfly of the family Pieridae, found on Sulawesi.

Lopharthrum is a monotypic moth genus of the family Erebidae erected by George Hampson in 1895. Its only species, Lopharthrum comprimens, was first described by Francis Walker in 1858. It is found from the Indian subregion to New Guinea and the Solomons.
Matapa celsina, is a butterfly in the family Hesperiidae. It is found in Celebes, and the Banggai Islands.

Olenecamptus bilobus is a species of beetle in the family Cerambycidae. It was described by Fabricius in 1801, originally under the genus Saperda. It is known from Myanmar, India, Papua New Guinea, Indonesia, Laos, Seychelles, Madagascar, Australia, Sri Lanka, Japan, Sumatra, Java, Philippines and Taiwan.

Pseudoboletia maculata is a species of sea urchin. It is found in the western central Pacific ocean. It is known in Indonesia, the tropical eastern Indian Ocean, and on the Great Barrier Reef. This species is reef-associated, and lives at depths of between 10 and 82 metres.

Saletara liberia is a butterfly of the family Pieridae. It is found in Indonesia, the Philippines, Peninsular Malaysia and various islands in the region. Subspecies S. l. distanti is known by the common name Malaysian albatross.
Terebralia palustris, common name the giant mangrove whelk, is a species of brackish-water snail, a gastropod mollusk in the family Potamididae.

Trapezia tigrina is a species of guard crab in the family Trapeziidae. The species was described in 1842 by Joseph Fortuné Théodore Eydoux and Louis François Auguste Souleyet. A common name for the species is red-spotted guard crab.
The pharaoh cuttlefish (Acanthosepion pharaonis) is a large cuttlefish species, growing to 42 cm in mantle length and 5 kg in weight.
Acosmeryx beatae is a moth of the family Sphingidae. It is known from Sulawesi.
Ambulyx inouei is a species of moth of the family Sphingidae. It is known from Sulawesi.

Amerila astreus is a moth of Arctiidae family. It is found from the Oriental region (including India, Sri Lanka) to New Guinea. The species is found in primary and secondary habitats ranging from the lowlands to montane regions.
Angonyx papuana is a moth of the family Sphingidae.
Arthroschista tricoloralis is a moth in the family Crambidae. It was described by Pagenstecher in 1888. It is found on Borneo.
Calappa gallus, common name rough box crab, or lumpy box crab, and Hawaiian name poki poki, is a benthic species of box crab in the family Calappidae.
Cupitha purreea, commonly known as the wax dart, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae and only species of the Cupitha genus.
Drupadia theda, the dark posy, is a species of butterfly belonging to the lycaenid family described by Cajetan Felder and Rudolf Felder in 1862. It is found in the Indomalayan realm.

Eudocima aurantia, known as fruit-sucking moth, is a moth of the family Erebidae. It is found across south-east Asia, from Sri-Lanka to northern Queensland, Australia. It is also present on the Andamans.
Eupanacra regularis is a moth of the family Sphingidae. It is known from India and south-east Asia, including Myanmar, Thailand, Malaysia (Peninsular) and Indonesia (Sumatra, Borneo, Java).

Forcipiger wanai, the Cenderawasih longnose butterflyfish, is a species of marine ray-finned fish, a butterflyfish from the family Chaetodontidae. It is endemic to Cenderawasih Bay in the Bird's Head Peninsula region of West Papua.
Heortia vitessoides is a moth of the Crambidae family. It is found in south-east Asia, including Fiji, Hong Kong, India, Taiwan, Thailand and northern Queensland in Australia.

Hypomeces pulviger, also known as the gold-dust weevil or green weevil, is a species of beetle in the true weevil family. The adult weevil can reach a length of about 14 mm (0.6 in) and is covered with iridescent green or yellowish-green dust-like scales all over the body.
Leucetta avocada is a species of calcareous sponge in the family Leucettidae, and was first described in 1954 by Laubenfels.
Logania marmorata, the pale mottle, is a butterfly in the family Lycaenidae. It was described by Frederic Moore in 1884. It is found in the Indomalayan realm.
Lophophelma funebrosa is a moth of the family Geometridae. It is found in the north-eastern Himalaya and Sundaland and on Sumbawa. The habitat consists of lowerland forests.
Oxymeris dimidiata, common name : the Orange Auger, is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Terebridae, the auger snails.
Patelloida striata is a species of sea snail, a true limpet, a marine gastropod mollusc in the family Lottiidae, one of the families of true limpets.
Phyllidiella lizae is a species of sea slug, a dorid nudibranch, a shell-less marine gastropod mollusk in the family Phyllidiidae.
Agathia lycaenaria is a species of moth of the family Geometridae. It is found from India to Australia.
Ambulyx tenimberi is a species of moth of the family Sphingidae. It is known from Sulawesi.

Arachnoides placenta is a species of sea urchin of the family Clypeasteridae. Their armour is covered with spines. It is placed in the genus Arachnoides and lives in the sea. Arachnoides placenta was first scientifically described in 1758 by Carl Linnaeus.
The Ramie Moth (Arcte coerula) is a moth of the Noctuidae family. It is found from in south-east Asia, including Fiji, India, Sri Lanka, Myanmar, Japan, New Guinea, Taiwan and Norfolk Island.
Chabula acamasalis is a moth of the Crambidae family. It is found in India, Burma, Sri Lanka, Hong Kong, Indonesia, Taiwan, Japan and much of Australia.
Choaspes plateni, the branded awlking, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae which is found in Asia.

Curetis insularis is a species of butterfly belonging to the lycaenid family. It is found in the Indomalayan realm (Java, Peninsular Malaya, Borneo, Sumatra, Thailand). Curetis insularis was described by Horsfield in 1829.
Drepane punctata, commonly known as the concertina fish or banded sicklefish, is a fish native to the waters of northern Australia and New Guinea.
Euchomenella heteroptera is a species of mantis, also known as the "giraffe mantis", in the family Deroplatyidae.

Eucidaris metularia, the ten-lined urchin, is a species of sea urchins in the family Cidaridae. It is found in shallow parts of the Indo-Pacific Ocean and is characterised by its sparse covering of banded, flat-tipped spines.
Gnathothlibus dabrera is a moth of the family Sphingidae. It is known from Sulawesi.
Habrona papuata is a moth in the family Drepanidae. It is found in Papua and Papua New Guinea, where it has been recorded from mountainous areas.

Hymenia perspectalis, the spotted beet webworm moth, is a species of moth of the Crambidae family. It is found in various parts of the world, including North America, where it is found from Maine to Florida, west to Texas and north to Michigan and Ontario.

Nembrotha purpureolineata is a species of colourful sea slug, a dorid nudibranch, a marine gastropod mollusc in the family Polyceridae. Nembrotha rutilans, classified as a separate species until 2008, has now been reclassified as Nembrotha purpureolineata.
Notocrypta feisthamelii, the spotted demon, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae.
Olene mendosa (brown tussock moth) is a species of moth found in India, Taiwan, Borneo and Australia.

Serrognathus titanus is a species of beetle in the family Lucanidae. It was described by Jean Baptiste Boisduval in 1835. Huang and Chen (2013) separated Serognathus from the genus Dorcus by representing morphological characters and DNA analysis.

Stenomelania plicaria, commonly known as the chopstick snail or the yellow chopstick snail, is a species of trumpet snail, first described by I. von Born under the synonymized name Helix pilcaria (Index rerum naturalium Musei Cæsarei Vindobonensis (pg. 403)).
Tajuria mantra, the Felder's royal, is a butterfly in the Lycaenidae family. It is found in Asia.
Tetragonus lycaenoides is a moth of the family Callidulidae. It is found in Sulawesi, Borneo, Peninsular Malaysia, Sumatra and Nias.

Theretra alecto, known as the Levant hawk moth, is a moth of the family Sphingidae. It is found in the Indomalaya ecozone and warm parts of the Palearctic ecozone, including extreme south-eastern Europe.
Amphidromus sinistralis, common name the sinistral bulimus, is a species of air-breathing land snail, a terrestrial pulmonate gastropod mollusc in the family Camaenidae....
Antheraea celebensis is a moth of the family Saturniidae. It is found in Sulawesi and Sundaland.
Anthozela hilaris is a species of moth of the family Tortricidae. It is found on Borneo and in Australia, where it has been recorded from Queensland.
Appias indra, the plain puffin, is a small butterfly of the family Pieridae, that is, the yellows and whites, which is found in India and Southeast Asia.

Appias paulina, the common albatross, Christmas Island white or Ceylon lesser albatross, is a butterfly of the family Pieridae. It is found from India to Samoa, including Indonesia, Japan, Malaysia, New Caledonia, Sri Lanka, Thailand and Australia.

Astropecten polyacanthus, bintang laut penyaring pasir atau bintang laut sisir, adalah sebuah bintang laut dari famili Astropectinidae. Spesies tersebut merupakan spesies paling tersebar dalam genus Astropecten, ditemukan di seluruh kawasan Indo-Pasifik. Rentang lengannya berukuran sampai 20 cm (8 in).
Brahmaea celebica is a species of moth of the Brahmaeidae family. It is found on Sulawesi.
Brissus latecarinatus is a species of sea urchins of the Family Brissidae. Their armour is covered with spines. Brissus latecarinatus was first scientifically described in 1778 by Leske.
Cirrhochrista brizoalis is a moth of the Crambidae family. It is found across south and south-east Asia from India to Taiwan and New Guinea and in Australia.
Cirrochroa thule, is a species of nymphalid butterfly found in Sulawesi.
Delias battana is a butterfly in the family Pieridae. It was described by Hans Fruhstorfer on 1896. It is endemic to Celebes.
Delias melusina is a butterfly in the family Pieridae. It was described by Otto Staudinger in 1890. It is found in the Australasian realm, where it is endemic to Sulawesi.
Diacamma rugosum, also known as Bornean queenless ant, is a species of ant of the subfamily Ponerinae. It is found from many countries throughout the world. 20 subspecies are recognized.
Drupella cornus, common name : the horn drupe, is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Muricidae, the murex snails or rock snails.

species.name: Kuda
species.summary: Kuda, jaran, atau aswa (Equus caballus atau Equus ferus caballus) adalah mamalia berkuku ganjil yang telah didomestikasi. Kuda tergolong dalam keluarga taksonomi Equidae dan merupakan salah satu daripada dua subspesies Equus ferus yang masih ada.
Eurypteryx bhaga is a moth of the family Sphingidae.
Harpa amouretta, common name the lesser harp, is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Harpidae, the harp snails.

Hippotion rafflesii, the Raffles' striated hawkmoth, is a moth of the family Sphingidae. It is known from Sri Lanka, southern and eastern India, Nepal, Myanmar, Thailand, southern China, Malaysia (Peninsular), Indonesia (Sumatra, Java, Sulawesi) and the Philippines.
Lentigo lentiginosus, common name the silver conch, is a species of medium-sized sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Strombidae, the true conchs....

Lydia annulipes is a species of crab in the family Oziidae. Coloration varies from brown to red brown to purple, with purple or red brown bands on the walking legs. The right claw of individuals collected has been found to be larger than the left claw.
Megachile frontalis is a species of bee in the family Megachilidae. It was described by Johan Christian Fabricius in 1804.
Nassarius pullus, common names : black nassa; olive dog whelk; ribbed dog whelk, is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Nassariidae, the Nassa mud snails or dog whelks.
Nerita exuvia, common name the "snakeskin nerite", is a medium-sized species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusc in the family Neritidae, the nerites.
Nupserha fricator is a species of beetle in the family Cerambycidae. It was described by Dalman in 1817. It is known from Java, Sulawesi, India, Myanmar, Philippines, Sumatra, Malaysia, and Thailand.

Oryctes gnu, commonly known as Malaysian rhinoceros beetle, is a species of dung beetle native to South Asian and South East Asian countries including: India, Pakistan, Sri Lanka, Philippines, Thailand, Philippines, and Vietnam. It is also introduced to many parts of the world.
Pelates quadrilineatus, also known as Trumpeter perch or fourlined terapon, is a fish species.

images.credit: Smithsonian Institution, National Museum of Natural History, Department of Verte

species.summary: Perna perna (brown mussel) is an economically important mussel, a bivalve mollusc belonging to the family Mytilidae. It is harvested as a food source but is also known to harbor toxins and cause damage to marine structures.
Phyllium letiranti adalah spesies Phasmatodea dari genus Phyllium. Spesies ini hanya dapat ditemukan di pulau Peleng, Indonesia.
Platydoris cruenta is a species of sea slug, a dorid nudibranch, shell-less marine opisthobranch gastropod mollusks in the family Discodorididae.
Stenomelania torulosa is a species of a freshwater snail, an aquatic gastropod mollusk in the family Thiaridae.
Tajuria iapyx is a butterfly endemic to the island of Sulawesi. It was described by William Chapman Hewitson in 1865.
Theretra hausmanni is a moth of the family Sphingidae. It is known from Sulawesi in Indonesia.
Tinolius eburneigutta is a moth of the family Erebidae first described by Francis Walker in 1855. It is found in India, Sri Lanka, and Thailand.
Tonna canaliculata is a species of large sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Tonnidae, the tun shells.
Tridrepana fulvata is a moth in the Drepanidae family. It was described by Snellen in 1876. It is found in China, India, Myanmar, Malaysia and Indonesia.
Zicrona caerulea, common name Blue Shieldbug, is a species of bugs belonging to the Pentatomidae family.
Abatocera leonina is a species of beetle in the family Cerambycidae. It was described by Thomson in 1865. It is known from the Philippines and the Celebes Islands.

Aporandria specularia is a species of moth of the family Geometridae. It is found in Sri Lanka, India, Vietnam, Thailand, the Andamans, Peninsular Malaysia, Sumatra, Borneo, the Philippines and Sulawesi.
Capila phanaeus, commonly known as the fulvous dawnfly, is a species of hesperid butterfly found in India and Southeast Asia.

images.credit: Frederic Moore (text); E. C. Knight / J N Fitch (art)

species.summary: The Green Garden Looper (Chrysodeixis eriosoma) is a moth of the family Noctuidae. Mostly cosmopolitan distribution, it is a serious pest found throughout Wadelai, Aden, Japan, China, throughout the Indian, Sri Lanka, Malayan, and Australasian regions.
Cleora inoffensa is a moth of the family Geometridae first described by Charles Swinhoe in 1902. It is found in the Himalayas, Sundaland, the Philippines, Sulawesi and on the Solomons.
Cupha arias is an Indomalayan species of heliconiine butterfly.
Discophora necho, the blue duffer, is a species of butterfly in the duffers group, that is, the Morphinae subfamily of the brush-footed butterflies family.

Erebus hieroglyphica is a moth of the Erebidae family. It is found from the Oriental tropical countries such as India, Pakistan, Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, Japan, China (including Hong Kong), Taiwan, Cambodia, Laos, Myanmar, Thailand, Vietnam, Indonesia, Philippines, Malaysia, Singapore, and Korea.
Euploea midamus, the blue spotted crow, is a butterfly found in India and South-East Asia that belongs to the crows and tigers, that is, the danaid group of the brush-footed butterflies family.

images.credit: Crabs' Promenade カニの散歩道

species.summary: Holocraspedon bilineata is a moth of the family Erebidae. It is found in Singapore, Thailand and the north-eastern Himalayas, as well as on Peninsular Malaysia, Borneo, Sulawesi and Sumbawa. The habitat consists of lowland forests and wet heath forests.
Lambis crocata, commonly known as the orange spider conch, is a species of large sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Strombidae, the true conchs.
Littoraria scabra, common name : the mangrove periwinkle, is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Littorinidae, the winkles or periwinkles.
Mancinella alouina, common names alou rock shell, alou rock snail, is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk, in the family Muricidae, the murex snails or rock snails.
Marumba amboinicus is a species of moth of the family Sphingidae. It is known from Indonesia and the Philippines.
Melo aethiopicus, common name the crowned baler, is a very large sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusc in the family Volutidae, the volutes.
Nacaduba pavana, the small four-line blue or Singapore four-line blue, is a species of lycaenid butterfly found in Southeast Asia.
Neochera marmorea is a moth in the family Noctuidae. It is found in Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, Sikkim and China (Yunnan)
Olepa ricini is a moth of the family Erebidae. It is found in India and Sri Lanka. An older treatment placed the species in the genus Pericallia
Oligodon tolaki atau kesiran tolaki adalah spesies ular dari famili Colubridae .
Prosotas gracilis or The Dark-based Lineblue is a butterfly in the family Lycaenidae. It was described by Julius Röber in 1886. It is found in the Indomalayan realm.
Rhinoclavis sinensis is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Cerithiidae.
Strigatella paupercula is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Mitridae, the miters or miter snails.

Teldenia specca is a moth in the Drepanidae family. It was described by Wilkinson in 1967. It is found in the north-eastern Himalayas and from western China to Borneo, Sumatra, Palawan, Buru and New Guinea.
Tetramorium bicarinatum, is a species of Formicidae family from the order Hymenoptera originated in South East Asia.
Tonna perdix, common name the partridge tun, is a species of very large sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusc in the family Tonnidae, the tun shells.

Vespa fervida is a rare species of hornet endemic to parts of Indonesia, primarily on the island of Sulawesi. Its range is quite small, with scattered populations and nesting colonies found on very rare occasions.

Achaea janata, the castor semi-looper or croton caterpillar, is an erebid moth, the caterpillars of which are termed 'semi-loopers' due to their mode of locomotion. It is found from the Indo-Australian tropics and subtropics, extending south to New Zealand and east through the Pacific archipelagoes to Easter Island.
Allotinus albatus is a butterfly in the family Lycaenidae. It was described by father and son entomologists Cajetan and Rudolf Felder in 1865. It is found on Sulawesi and the Philippines (Luzon).

Anchiale maculata is a medium-sized stick insect found on the Maluku Islands, Peleng Island and Kei Islands. Anchiale maculata was first described by Oliver in 1792 as Mantis maculata. The genus Anchiale was introduced by Stål (1875) with the type species Anchiale maculata.
Arhopala irregularis is a butterfly in the family Lycaenidae. It was described by George Thomas Bethune-Baker in 1903. It is found in Sulawesi and Banggai in the Australasian realm.
Batocera gerstaeckerii is a species of beetle in the family Cerambycidae. It was described by Thomson in 1865. It is known from the Moluccas.
Belionota sumptuosa, commonly known as the Tricolor Metallic Wood-boring Beetle, is a jewel beetle of the Buprestidae family. It is found in Indonesia.
Bindahara phocides, the plane, is a small butterfly found Indomalayan (including India) and Australasian realms that belongs to the lycaenids or blues family.
Charaxes musashi, the Sulawesi tawny rajah, is a butterfly in the family Nymphalidae. It was described by Etsuzo Tsukada in 1991. It is endemic to Sulawesi in the Australasian realm.
Chondromorpha xanthotricha, is a species of millipedes in the family Paradoxosomatidae. It is native to South India and Sri Lanka. Two subspecies recognized.

Cryptophyllium celebicum, simply known as walking leaf mimic insect, is type species of leaf insect in the new (2021) genus Cryptophyllium, which has been placed the tribe Phylliini. Its recorded distribution is Sulawesi and Ambon Island.
Dappula tertia is a moth of the Psychidae family. It is widely distributed in the Indo-Australian region, where it is found from India to the Solomon Islands. The habitat consists of lowland areas.

Eumeta variegata, the paulownia bagworm, is a moth of the family Psychidae. The species was first described by Snellen in 1879. It is found in Japan, Papua New Guinea, India, the Solomon Islands and Sri Lanka.
The small brown crow (Euploea darchia) is a butterfly found in Australia that belongs to the crows and tigers, that is, the danaid group of the brush-footed butterflies family.
Eupterote celebica is a moth in the family Eupterotidae. It was described by Wolfgang A. Nässig, Jeremy Daniel Holloway and Martin Beeke in 2011. It is found in Sulawesi, Indonesia.
Eurema irena is a butterfly in the family Pieridae. It is endemic to Sulawesi.
Glenea basalis is a species of beetle in the family Cerambycidae. It was described by James Thomson in 1865.
Hasora leucospila is a species of butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae which is found in Southeast Asia, Cambodia.

Heterocnephes lymphatalis is a moth in the Crambidae family. It was described by Charles Swinhoe in 1889. It is found in China, Thailand, Cambodia, Peninsular Malaysia, north-eastern India and Burma, as well as on the Mollucas, Borneo, Sulawesi and Java.
Hexaplex cichoreum, common name the "endive murex", is a medium-sized species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Muricidae, the murex shells or rock snails.
Hyblaea saturata is a moth in the family Hyblaeidae described by Francis Walker in 1865.

Idea idea, or Linnaeus' idea, is a large butterfly that belongs to the danaid group of the family Nymphalidae. It was described by Carl Linnaeus in his 1763 Centuria Insectorum. It is found in the Australasian realm.
Ilma is a genus of skippers in the family Hesperiidae. It is monotypic, being represented by the single species, Ilma irvina.

Iraota rochana, the scarce silverstreak, is a species of lycaenid or blue butterfly with several subspecies found in (Manipur, Burma, Java, Borneo, Sumatra, Malaya, Langkawi, Thailand, Singapore, Sulawesi and the Philippines.
Leptogenys diminuta is a species of ant of the subfamily Ponerinae. Twelve subspecies are recognized.
Mammilla melanostoma is a species of predatory sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Naticidae, the moon snails.
Milionia paradisea is a moth in the genus Milionia native to the islands of New Guinea and Sulawesi, Indonesia.
Nacaduba angusta, the white lineblue, is a species of lycaenid butterfly found in South Asia.
Nacaduba subperusia, the violet 4-lineblue, is a butterfly in the family Lycaenidae. It was described by Pieter Cornelius Tobias Snellen in 1896. It is found in the Indomalayan realm.
Nerita chamaeleon is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Neritidae.

Raunga besar peleng (Nesiophasma giganteum) adalah spesies phasmatodea yang ditemukan di Pulau Peleng. Individu betina dewasa biasanya berukuran besar, kira-kira memiliki ukuran tubuh antara 250 hingga 300 mm atau 10–12 inci. Baik individu jantan atau betina tidak memiliki sayap.

Orvasca subnotata is a nygmiine tussock moth in the family Erebidae, found in Indomalaya and East Asia, where it is known as a pest that feeds on millets. The species was first described by Francis Walker in 1865.

species.name: Semut Gatal
species.summary: Carebara diversa is a species of ants in the subfamily Formicinae. It is found in many Asian countries.

Platycrana is the type genus of the reconstituted subfamily Platycraninae: which are stick insects from the Asia-Pacific region. They belong to the monotypic tribe Platycranini Brunner von Wattenwyl, 1893.
Proatta is a Southeast Asian genus of ants in the subfamily Myrmicinae. It contains the single species Proatta butteli, known from the Malay Peninsula, Borneo and Sumatra.
Problepsis apollinaria is a moth of the family Geometridae. It is found from the Indian Subregion to New Guinea and Queensland.
Prosotas pia, the margined lineblue, is a species of blue (Lycaenidae) butterfly found in Asia.

Rhodoneura pudicula is a species of moth of the Thyrididae family. It is found in Thailand, West Sumatra, West Malaysia, Brunei, Borneo (Sabah), Kalimantan, Java, Bali, Sulawesi, West Papua and Papua New Guinea in lowlands and lower montane forests at altitudes below 1400 m.

Saletara liberia is a butterfly of the family Pieridae. It is found in Indonesia, the Philippines, Peninsular Malaysia and various islands in the region. Subspecies S. l. distanti is known by the common name Malaysian albatross.
Sulawesiella rafaelae is a species of beetle in the family Cerambycidae, and the only species in the genus Sulawesiella. It was described by Lansberge in 1885.
Terastia egialealis is a moth in the Crambidae family, Spilomelinae subfamily. It is found in India, China, Nepal, Thailand, West Malaysia, Sumatra, Java, Borneo, and Sulawesi.
Tonna allium, common name the costate tun, is a species of large sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Tonnidae, the tun shells.
Aiteta damnipennis is a moth of the family Nolidae first described by Francis Walker in 1865. It is found in Sri Lanka, India, Peninsular Malaysia, Sumatra, Borneo and Sulawesi.
Allotinus samarensis is a butterfly in the family Lycaenidae. It was described by John Nevill Eliot in 1986. It is found in the Philippines.
Astygisa vexillaria is a moth of the family Geometridae first described by Achille Guenée in 1858. It is found in Sri Lanka, the Indian subregion and Sundaland.

Biston regalis is a moth of the family Geometridae. It is found in China (Liaoning, Henan, Shaanxi, Gansu, Zhejiang, Hubei, Jiangxi, Hunan, Fujian, Hainan, Sichuan, Yunnan), Taiwan, Russia (Amur, Ussuri), Japan, North Korea, South Korea, India, Nepal, the Philippines, Pakistan and the United States.
Cephrenes augiades, the orange palm dart, is a butterfly of the Hesperiidae family. It is found from Indonesia to the Solomons.
Cicindela opigrapha is a species of tiger beetle. This species is found in Indonesia.

Comostola chlorargyra is a moth of the family Geometridae first described by Francis Walker in 1861. It is found in Sri Lanka, the Indian subregion, the Andaman Islands, Borneo, Java, the Philippines, Sulawesi and Australia.

Cydalima laticostalis is a moth in the Crambidae family. It was described by Guenée in 1854. It is found from India, Sri Lanka, Burma and Malaysia to the New Hebrides. It is also found in Australia, where it has been recorded from tropical Queensland.

Cymo melanodactylus, the furry coral crab, is a species of small decapod crustacean in the family Xanthidae. It is found in the Indo-Pacific Ocean and lives in crevices and on the surface of corals in the genus Acropora.

Dentalium elephantinum, the elephant tusk, is a species of scaphopod mollusc. Its shell is often deep green fading to white at its tip and has between eight and 17 strong ribs along its sides. Adults are about 70 mm in length with an diameter of about 11 mm at the shell aperture.
Diamesus osculans, is a species of carrion beetle found in Sri Lanka, Indonesia, Philippines, Laos, China, Australia.
Echineulima asthenosomae is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Eulimidae.

Ecliptopera rectilinea is a species of moth of the family Geometridae. It is found in the north-eastern parts of the Himalaya, Taiwan, northern Thailand, Peninsular Malaysia, Borneo, Bali, Sumbawa and Sulawesi.
Epepeotes lugubris is a species of beetle in the family Cerambycidae. It was described by Francis Polkinghorne Pascoe in 1866, originally under the genus Diochares. It is known from Sulawesi.
Erebus nyctaculis is a moth of the family Erebidae. It is found from Mindanao and Indonesia (including Java and Sulawesi) south to northern Australia.
Exaiptasia diaphana, the pale anemone, is a species from the genus Exaiptasia.
Glenea lachrymosa is a species of beetle in the family Cerambycidae. It was described by Francis Polkinghorne Pascoe in 1867. It is known from Sulawesi.

Glossodoris cincta is a species of sea slug, a dorid nudibranch, a shell-less marine gastropod mollusk in the family Chromodorididae. This name has been extensively used for a group of similarly coloured species, some of which are un-named.
Huttonella bicolor is a species of land snail in the family Streptaxidae known commonly as the two-toned gulella.
Hebomoia leucippe is a butterfly in the family Pieridae. It is endemic to the Moluccas and Peleng in Indonesia. The wingspan of H. leucippe is approximately 8 cm (3.1 in).

images.credit: Smithsonian Institution, National Museum of Natural History, Department of Entom
Smithsonian Institution, National Museum of Natural History, Department of Entom

species.summary: Heterogymna ochrogramma is a moth in the family Carposinidae. It was described by Edward Meyrick in 1913. It is found in Bhutan, China and Japan.
Horaga syrinx, the yellow onyx, is a species of lycaenid or hairstreak butterfly found in Asia.
Hypselodoris melanesica is a species of sea slug or dorid nudibranch, a marine gastropod mollusc in the family Chromodorididae.
Longicella mollis is a species of moth of the family Noctuidae first described by Francis Walker in 1856.
Lophophelma albapex is a moth of the family Geometridae first described by Hiroshi Inoue in 1988. It is found on Sulawesi.
Lophophelma vigens is a moth of the family Geometridae. It is found in the Himalaya and on Peninsular Malaysia, Sumatra and Borneo. The habitat consists of lower and upper montane forests.
Nassarius olivaceus, common name: the olivaceous nassa, is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusc in the family Nassariidae, the nassa mud snails or dog whelks.
Nerita planospira is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Neritidae.
Nirvanopsis is a butterfly genus from the subfamily Satyrinae in the family Nymphalidae. The only species in the genus, Nirvanopsis hypnus, occurs in Indonesia.
Nomia formosa is a species of bee in the genus Nomia of the family Halictidae.

Ochetellus glaber (also known as the black household ant) is a species of ant native to Australia. A member of the genus Ochetellus in the subfamily Dolichoderinae, it was described by Austrian entomologist Gustav Mayr in 1862. Aside from Australia, O.
Ommatophora luminosa is a species of moth in the Erebidae family. The species is found from the Himalayas and Taiwan to Sundaland.

Ossonoba is a monotypic moth genus in the family Erebidae. Its only species, Ossonoba torpida, is found in Darjeeling, India. Both the genus and the species were first described by Francis Walker in 1866.
Oxygoniola is a genus of tiger beetles. This genus has a single species, Oxygoniola chamaeleon. It is found in Indonesia.
Parotis suralis is a moth of the Crambidae family. It is found around the west Pacific rim, including Chagos Islands, Hong Kong, Japan, Kiribati, Tuvalu and the tropical far north of Queensland.
Appias aegis, the forest white, is a butterfly in the family Pieridae. It is found in south-east Asia.

Phyllodes eyndhovii is a noctuoid moth in the family Erebidae, subfamily Calpinae. The species was first described by Samuel Constantinus Snellen van Vollenhoven in 1858. It is found in the Himalayas, western China, Taiwan, Thailand, Sundaland and Palawan.

Plagusia squamosa is a marine crab of the family Plagusiidae, formerly considered a subspecies of Plagusia depressa (as P. d. tuberculata). It is found in tropical Indo-Pacific oceans. P. squamosa's carapace is bumpy and quite coarse, seemingly scaly, leading to its common name: The Scaly Rock Crab.
Planaxis sulcatus, common name the tropical periwinkle, is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Planaxidae.

Potanthus pava, commonly known as the Pava dart, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae. It is found from southern India to central China, Taiwan, Malaysia, the Philippines, and Sulawesi, Indonesia.
Problepsis achlyobathra is a species of moth of the family Geometridae. It is found in Sumatra, Peninsular Malaysia, Borneo, Java and Sulawesi.
Progonia oileusalis is a moth of the family Noctuidae first described by Francis Walker in 1859. It is found in Sri Lanka, Borneo, India, Taiwan, Japan and the Philippines.
Psilogramma sulawesica is a moth of the family Sphingidae. It is known from Sulawesi in Indonesia.

Pycnarmon jaguaralis is a moth in the family Crambidae. It was described by Achille Guenée in 1854. It is found in Australia, Papua New Guinea, Indonesia (Seram), the Himalayas, India (Assam), Bhutan and from Malaysia to the Solomon Islands.
Terestrombus fragilis, common name : the Fragile Conch, is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Strombidae, the true conchs.
Terinos atlita is a butterfly in the family Nymphalidae. It was described by Johann Christian Fabricius in 1787. It is found in the Indomalayan realm.
Theretra boisduvalii is a moth of the family Sphingidae.
Tibia fusus, common name Spindle tibia or Shinbone Tibia Gastropod, is a species of large sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Strombidae, the true conchs.
Vittina gagates is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Neritidae.
Abisara echerius, the plum Judy, is a small but striking butterfly found in Asia belonging to the Punches and Judies family (Riodinidae). It is difficult to distinguish it from Abisara bifasciata.
Abisara kausambi, the straight plum Judy, is a small but striking butterfly found in the Indomalayan realm that belongs to the Punches and Judies, that is, the family Riodinidae.

Acalolepta celebensis adalah spesies kumbang tanduk panjang yang berasal dari famili Cerambycidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Acalolepta, ordo Coleoptera, kelas Insecta, filum Arthropoda, dan kingdom Animalia.
Aedes vexans, the inland floodwater mosquito, is a cosmopolitan and common pest mosquito.
Aethalida rudis is a moth of the family Erebidae. It was described by Francis Walker in 1864. It is found on Sulawesi in Indonesia.
Allopeas gracile, common name the graceful awlsnail, is a species of small, tropical, air-breathing land snail, a terrestrial pulmonate gastropod mollusk in the family Subulinidae.
Amsactoides solitaria is a moth of the family Erebidae. It was described by Alfred Ernest Wileman in 1910. It is found in Taiwan.

Apsarasa radians is a moth of the Noctuidae family. It is found in the north-eastern parts of the Himalaya, south-eastern Asia, the Andamans, Peninsular Malaysia, Sumatra, Borneo, the Philippines and Sulawesi.
Ariadne merionoides, the Holland's castor, is a butterfly in the family Nymphalidae. It is found in Sulawesi.

species.name: Kekep Babi
species.summary: Kekep babi (bahasa Latin: Artamus leucorynchus) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Artamidae, dari genus Artamus. Burung ini merupakan jenis burung pemakan serangga kecil, kumbang, leba dan memiliki habitat di pesisir, sawah, kebun, tegalan, hutan sekunder. tersebar sampai ketinggian 1.500 m dpl.
Asota albivena is a moth of the family Erebidae first described by Francis Walker in 1864. It is found in Sulawesi, Maluku and the Kai Islands.
Athyma libnites is butterfly endemic to Sulawesi, Indonesia. It was described by William Chapman Hewitson in 1859.
Bibasis etelka, the great orange awlet, is a species of skipper described by William Chapman Hewitson in 1871.
Borbo impar, the yellow swift, is a butterfly of the Hesperiidae family. It is found from the Northern Territory of Australia and Indonesia to the Solomons
Bibasis harisa, the orange awlet, is a species of hesperid found in Asia. The butterfly was reassigned to genus Burara by Vane-Wright and de Jong (2003) and is considered by them to be Burara harisa.

Bibasis oedipodea, the branded orange awlet, is a species of hesperid butterfly found in South Asia and Southeast Asia. The butterfly was reassigned to the genus Burara by Vane-Wright and de Jong (2003) and is considered by them to be Burara oedipodea.
Calliphara excellens is a jewel bug in the family Scutelleridae. It is distributed in Nepal and India.
Cassidula nucleus is a species of air-breathing marine snail, a pulmonate gastropod mollusk in the family Ellobiidae.
Choeromorpha flavolineata is a species of beetle in the family Cerambycidae. It was described by Breuning in 1939. It is known from Sulawesi.
Cicindela mamasa is a species of tiger beetle. This species is found in Indonesia, where it has been recorded from Sulawesi.

Cirrhochrista annulifera is a moth in the family Crambidae. It is found in Papua New Guinea, on the D'Entrecasteaux Islands (Fergusson Island, Goodenough Island) and in Australia, where it has been recorded from Western Australia, the Northern Territory and Queensland.
Clithon oualaniense is a species of brackish water snail with an operculum, a nerite. It is an aquatic gastropod mollusk in the family Neritidae, the nerites.

species.summary: Culex sitiens is an insect native to coastal areas of East Africa and Madagascar, southwestern Asia, Ryukyu Archipelago, Korea, northern Australia and South Pacific islands.

Doesburgia celebiana is a species of beetle in the family Cerambycidae, and the only species in the genus Doesburgia. It was described by Tippmann in 1953. It was named after the Dutch town of Doesburg....
Dophla evelina, the redspot duke, is a species of brush-footed butterfly found in South and Southeast Asia (Sri Lanka, Yunnan and India to the Philippines and Sulawesi). Many subspecies are accepted.
Dysallacta megalopa is a species of moth of the family Crambidae described by Edward Meyrick in 1889. It is found in Papua New Guinea and in Australia.

Elysia ornata, commonly known as ornate elysia or ornate leaf slug, is a species of sea slug, a marine gastropod mollusk. This sea slug superficially resembles a nudibranch, yet it does not belong to that suborder of gastropods.

The blue trevally (Ferdauia ferdau), also known as the banded trevally, barred trevally, Ferdau's trevally or Forskaal's jackfish, is a common, widespread species of pelagic marine fish classified in the jack family, Carangidae.

species.name: Tutut Jawa
species.summary: Tutut jawa (Filopaludina javanica) adalah sejenis siput air tawar anggota suku Viviparidae. Siput atau keong yang biasa ditemukan di sawah atau sungai ini acap dikonsumsi sebagai sumber protein yang murah dan mudah didapat, terutama di perdesaan di Jawa.
Gasterocome pannosaria is a moth in the family Geometridae. It is found from northern India, Nepal, Bhutan and Indochina to Sundaland and Taiwan.

Glenea celestis adalah spesies kumbang tanduk panjang yang tergolong famili Cerambycidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Glenea, ordo Coleoptera, kelas Insecta, filum Arthropoda, dan kingdom Animalia.
Halgerda okinawa is a species of sea slug, a dorid nudibranch, shell-less marine gastropod mollusks in the family Discodorididae.

Hippotion boerhaviae is a moth of the family Sphingidae. It is known from Sri Lanka, India, Nepal, Thailand, south-eastern China (Hong Kong and Guangdong), Vietnam, Indonesia, the Philippines, eastern Australia and New Caledonia.
Hyblaea firmamentum is a moth in the family Hyblaeidae described by Achille Guenée in 1852.
Lebeda intermedia is a moth of the family Lasiocampidae. It is found in Borneo, Sumatra and Peninsular Malaysia.
Littoraria pallescens is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Littorinidae, the winkles or periwinkles.
Lohora ophthalmica is a butterfly in the Nymphalidae family. It is found in north-eastern Sulawesi (Sulawesi mainland, the islands of Buton and Kabaena).
Lygniodes ochrifera is a moth of the family Erebidae. It is found in Indonesia (Sulawesi, Moluccas).
Mansonia (Mansonioides) uniformis is a species of zoophilic mosquito belonging to the genus Mansonia.
Mycalesis visala, the long-brand bushbrown, is a species of satyrine butterfly found in Asia. It might include the Tamil bushbrown as a subspecies.

species.summary: Nassarius arcularia, common name : the casket nassa or the little box dog whelk, is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Nassariidae, the Nassa mud snails or dog whelks.

Nausinoe globulipedalis is a moth in the family Crambidae. It was described by Francis Walker in 1866. It is found in Indonesia (Sulawesi), New Guinea and Australia, where it has been recorded from Queensland.
Neptis sappho, the Pallas' sailer or common glider, is a nymphalid butterfly found in Central Europe, Russia, India and other parts of temperate Asia and Japan.
Nyctemera obtusa is a moth of the family Erebidae first described by Francis Walker in 1856. It is found on Sulawesi in Indonesia.
Oliva tigridella is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Olividae, the olives.

Omiodes surrectalis is a moth in the family Crambidae. Described by Francis Walker in 1866, it is found in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, India, Indonesia (Java, Sulawesi), the Philippines, Sri Lanka, New Guinea and Queensland, Australia.

Omphisa anastomosalis, the sweetpotato vineborer, is a moth of the Crambidae family. It is widespread, with records including the Philippines, Indonesia, New Guinea, India, Sri Lanka, Malaysia, Taiwan, Hawaii, Vietnam, China, Japan, Cambodia, Laos, Burma and Thailand.
Pachynoa spilosomoides is a moth in the Crambidae family. It was described by Moore in 1886. It is found in Sri Lanka and the Philippines.
Pandercetes plumipes, is a species of spider of the genus Pandercetes. It is native to Ambon Islands, Sri Lanka and New Guinea.
Polyrhachis hippomanes is a species of ant in the subfamily Formicinae, found in Sri Lanka. Three subspecies are recognized. 2 subspecies were given full species status recently.
Pseudoborbo bevani, the Beavan's swift, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae. It is named after Captain Robert Cecil Beavan.
Pustularia cicercula is a species of sea snail, a cowry, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Cypraeidae, the cowries.
Rapala ribbei is a butterfly in the family Lycaenidae. It was described by Julius Rober in 1886. It is endemic to Sulawesi. The name honours Carl Ribbe.

Caplak sapi (Boophilus microplus atau Rhipicephalus microplus) adalah sejenis serangga yang menyerang sapi.Kerugian yang ditimbulkan umumnya karena menghisap darah menyebabkan anemia, merusak kulit, dermatitis.Namun perananya yang lebih penting adalah sebagai vektor penyakit piroplasmosis, anaplasmosis dan theileriosis…
Tajuria cyrillus is a butterfly in the family Lycaenidae. It is found only on Sulawesi in Indonesia.
Kapang atau kampang (bahasa Inggris: shipworm, artinya "cacing kapal") adalah sekelompok kerang air asin sejenis moluska bivalvia yang termasuk ke dalam famili Teredinidae, keluarga cacing kapal.
Triorbis annulata is a moth in the Nolidae family. It is found in Burma, Peninsular Malaysia, on Borneo and Luzon.
The coastal trevally (Carangoides coeruleopinnatus), also known as the onion trevally, Japanese trevally or bluefin kingfish, is a species of inshore marine fish in the jack family Carangidae.
Vexillum cookorum is a species of small sea snail, marine gastropod mollusk in the family Costellariidae, the ribbed miters.
